findings.text: Converting generic integer N to int via n := int(nth) allows overflow: passing int64(math.MinInt64) makes -n overflow to MinInt64, bypassing the bounds check at line 14 and causing panic on collection[l+n] with a negative index.
Large unsigned values wrap when converted to int: passing uint64(math.MaxUint64) becomes n=-1, bypassing bounds checks and incorrectly returning collection[l-1] instead of an out-of-bounds error.
